item.title: Massive explosions at Syrian army weapons depot near Aleppo
item.description: Explosions rocked a Syrian army ammunition depot south of Aleppo, injuring at least four people.

item.title: Imran Khan’s family says three sisters detained ahead of Islamabad march
item.description: Imran Khan’s family says three of his sisters have been detained in Lahore ahead of a march demanding his release.

item.title: Powerful explosions at Syrian army site near Aleppo injure at least four
item.description: Officials urge civilians to stay away from the site in al-Eis near Aleppo after a series of explosions.

item.title: Trump administration readies sweeping sanctions against ICC, reports say
item.description: Measures targeting the court itself could disrupt payments, IT services and investigations.

item.title: The Sahel and the UN: a smaller footprint, a different role
item.description: As UNGA 81 begins, the UN faces a changing Sahel demanding greater sovereignty.

item.title: Ethiopian armed groups forge alliance against government
item.description: Former adversaries say they will settle differences as fears grow of expanding war in Ethiopia.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran warns US against new strikes; fighting rages in Yemen
item.description: Tehran says it has learned the US may be planning a new round of strikes, warns of retaliation 'without limitations'.

item.title: ICE officer shoots and wounds man in Austin, Texas, officials say
item.description: An immigration attorney representing the man’s family identifies him as Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, a Venezuelan.

item.title: Ruling party dominates early results in Russia’s wartime parliamentary vote
item.description: The Kremlin wants the elections to showcase popular support for the war in Ukraine and legitimise its action.

item.title: France to summon Iran envoy after language centre closure in Tehran
item.description: Iran accuses the French language centre of conducting 'illegal acts that violated diplomatic conventions'.

item.title: Qatar PM urges Gulf security framework with Iran
item.description: Qatar’s PM says, the Gulf won't be the same unless there's a framework ensuring no one is a threat to each other.

item.title: Argentina’s Left stages ‘March of Anger’ over Milei’s austerity measures
item.description: Thousands of protesters took to the streets of Buenos Aires for the ‘March of Anger’.

item.title: Eighteen suspects extradited to US over Haitian president’s 2021 killing
item.description: Federal court in Florida to try men accused of orchestrating the transnational plot to kill Jovenel Moise from US soil.

item.title: Qatar PM describes fallout of US-Israel war on Iran as ‘earthquake’
item.description: Speaking before the UN General Assembly, Sheikh Mohammed also announces a key shift in Qatar's investment strategy.

item.title: US proposes AI safety notification mechanism in talks with China
item.description: Scott Bessent and He Lifeng meet in New York for US-China talks ahead of the Trump-Xi meeting later this week.

item.title: Qatar says it is working to revive Iran-US talks
item.description: Qatar’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson tells Bloomberg that mediators are shuttling between Iran and US to revive talks.

item.title: France’s Macron and Canada’s Carney announce plans to build stronger ties
item.description: Announcement comes as Canada seeks a closer relationship with the EU amid a trade war with the US.

item.title: How will Saudi Arabia deal with the Houthis?
item.description: Yemeni group warns of further attacks on the kingdom.

item.title: Man Utd salvage Fulham draw as pressure mounts on Carrick
item.description: Matheus Cunha strikes late as Manchester United seal a 1-1 draw at Fulham, but pressure mounts on Michael Carrick.

item.title: Gaza artists honour Macklemore for supporting Palestine
item.description: Artists in Gaza are painting murals on destroyed walls, honouring US rapper Macklemore for his support for Palestine.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Israel pardons soldier Elor Azaria
item.description: Jerusalem Daily: Israel pardons soldier Elor Azaria

item.title: Trump tariffs hit Canada’s dairy farmers as US sales stall
item.description: A 50 percent tariff has disrupted dairy exports, leaving Canadian farmers with milk that cannot be redirected overnight.

item.title: Meloni promises to ban burqas, niqabs in Italy’s schools
item.description: Prime minister of Italy's longest serving government since WW2 faces election threat from far-right rival party.

item.title: Central Colombia forest fire threatens tourist town of Villa de Leyva
item.description: The country has battled multiple wildfires amid record-breaking temperatures fuelled by El Nino and drought conditions.

item.title: Atletico Madrid beat 10-man Real Madrid 2-1 in feisty La Liga derby
item.description: The game hinged on Dean Huijsen's red card early in the second half for pulling down Giuliano Simeone in the box.
